verses.original: Τρίτον τοῦτο ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς Ἐπὶ στόματος δύο μαρτύρων καὶ τριῶν σταθήσεται πᾶν ῥῆμα
verses.transliteration: Triton touto erchomai pros hymas Epi stomatos dyo martyrōn kai triōn stathēsetai pan rhēma
verses.literal: This is the third time I am coming to you Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses
verses.literalPt: É ESTA a terceira vez que vou ter convosco. Por boca de duas ou três testemunhas será confirmada toda a palavra.

verses.original: Προείρηκα καὶ προλέγω ὡς παρὼν τὸ δεύτερον καὶ ἀπὼν νῦν τοῖς προημαρτηκόσιν καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς πᾶσιν ὅτι ἐὰν ἔλθω εἰς τὸ πάλιν οὐ φείσομαι
verses.transliteration: Proeirēka kai prolegō hōs parōn to deuteron kai apōn nyn tois proēmartēkosin kai tois loipois pasin hoti ean elthō eis to palin ou pheisomai
verses.literal: I already warned you . . . the second time I was with you So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else If I return I will not spare anyone
verses.literalPt: Já anteriormente o disse, e segunda vez o digo como quando estava presente; mas agora, estando ausente, o escrevo aos que antes pecaram e a todos os mais, que, se outra vez for, não lhes perdoarei;

verses.original: ἐπεὶ δοκιμὴν ζητεῖτε τοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ λαλοῦντος Χριστοῦ ὃς εἰς ὑμᾶς οὐκ ἀσθενεῖ ἀλλὰ δυνατεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: epei dokimēn zēteite tou en emoi lalountos Christou hos eis hymas ouk asthenei alla dynatei en hymin
verses.literal: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me He is not weak in dealing with you but is powerful among you
verses.literalPt: Visto que buscais uma prova de Cristo que fala em mim, o qual não é fraco para convosco, antes é poderoso entre vós.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐσταυρώθη ἐξ ἀσθενείας ἀλλὰ ζῇ ἐκ δυνάμεως Θεοῦ καὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἀσθενοῦμεν ἐν αὐτῷ ἀλλὰ ζήσομεν σὺν αὐτῷ ἐκ δυνάμεως Θεοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai gar estaurōthē ex astheneias alla zē ek dynameōs Theou kai gar hēmeis asthenoumen en autō alla zēsomen syn autō ek dynameōs Theou eis hymas
verses.literal: For He was indeed crucified in weakness yet He lives by God’s power For we are also weak in Him yet by God’s power we will live with Him concerning you
verses.literalPt: Porque, ainda que foi crucificado por fraqueza, vive, contudo, pelo poder de Deus. Porque nós também somos fracos nele, mas viveremos com ele pelo poder de Deus em vós.

verses.original: Ἑαυτοὺς πειράζετε εἰ ἐστὲ ἐν τῇ πίστει ἑαυτοὺς δοκιμάζετε ἢ οὐκ ἐπιγινώσκετε ἑαυτοὺς ὅτι Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν εἰ μήτι ἀδόκιμοί ἐστε
verses.transliteration: Heautous peirazete ei este en tē pistei heautous dokimazete ē ouk epiginōskete heautous hoti Iēsous Christos en hymin ei mēti adokimoi este
verses.literal: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith test yourselves Do you not realize that Jesus Christ is in you unless . . . you fail the test
verses.literalPt: Examinai-vos a vós mesmos, se permaneceis na fé; provai-vos a vós mesmos. Ou não sabeis quanto a vós mesmos, que Jesus Cristo está em vós? Se não é que já estais reprovados.

verses.original: ἐλπίζω δὲ ὅτι γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἐσμὲν ἀδόκιμοι
verses.transliteration: elpizō de hoti gnōsesthe hoti hēmeis ouk esmen adokimoi
verses.literal: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test
verses.literalPt: Mas espero que entendereis que nós não somos reprovados.

verses.original: Εὐχόμεθα δὲ πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν μὴ ποιῆσαι ὑμᾶς κακὸν μηδέν οὐχ ἵνα ἡμεῖς δόκιμοι φανῶμεν ἀλλ’ ἵνα ὑμεῖς τὸ καλὸν ποιῆτε ἡμεῖς δὲ ὡς ἀδόκιμοι ὦμεν
verses.transliteration: Euchometha de pros ton Theon mē poiēsai hymas kakon mēden ouch hina hēmeis dokimoi phanōmen all’ hina hymeis to kalon poiēte hēmeis de hōs adokimoi ōmen
verses.literal: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong not that we will appear to have stood the test but that you will do what is right even if we appear to have failed
verses.literalPt: Ora, eu rogo a Deus que não façais mal algum, não para que sejamos achados aprovados, mas para que vós façais o bem, embora nós sejamos como reprovados.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ δυνάμεθά τι κατὰ τῆς ἀληθείας ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ τῆς ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: ou gar dynametha ti kata tēs alētheias alla hyper tēs alētheias
verses.literal: For we cannot do anything against the truth but only for the truth
verses.literalPt: Porque nada podemos contra a verdade, senão pela verdade.

verses.original: χαίρομεν γὰρ ὅταν ἡμεῖς ἀσθενῶμεν ὑμεῖς δὲ δυνατοὶ ἦτε τοῦτο καὶ εὐχόμεθα τὴν ὑμῶν κατάρτισιν
verses.transliteration: chairomen gar hotan hēmeis asthenōmen hymeis de dynatoi ēte touto kai euchometha tēn hymōn katartisin
verses.literal: In fact we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong and our prayer is for your perfection
verses.literalPt: Porque nos regozijamos de estar fracos, quando vós estais fortes; e o que desejamos é a vossa perfeição.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ταῦτα ἀπὼν γράφω ἵνα παρὼν μὴ ἀποτόμως χρήσωμαι κατὰ τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἣν ὁ Κύριος ἔδωκέν μοι εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν
verses.transliteration: Dia touto tauta apōn graphō hina parōn mē apotomōs chrēsōmai kata tēn exousian hēn ho Kyrios edōken moi eis oikodomēn kai ouk eis kathairesin
verses.literal: This is why . . . I write these things while absent so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up not for tearing you down
verses.literalPt: Portanto, escrevo estas coisas estando ausente, para que, estando presente, não use de rigor, segundo o poder que o Senhor me deu para edificação, e não para destruição.

verses.original: Λοιπόν ἀδελφοί χαίρετε καταρτίζεσθε παρακαλεῖσθε τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖτε εἰρηνεύετε καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Loipon adelphoi chairete katartizesthe parakaleisthe to auto phroneite eirēneuete kai ho Theos tēs agapēs kai eirēnēs estai meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: Finally brothers rejoice Aim for perfect harmony encourage one another be of one mind live in peace And the God of love and peace will be with you
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao mais, irmãos, regozijai-vos, sede perfeitos, sede consolados, sede de um mesmo parecer, vivei em paz; e o Deus de amor e de paz será convosco.

verses.literal: Greet one another with a holy kiss
verses.literalPt: Saudai-vos uns aos outros com ósculo santo.

verses.literal: All the saints send you greetings . . .

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἡ κοινωνία τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou kai hē agapē tou Theou kai hē koinōnia tou Hagiou Pneumatos meta pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ and the love of God and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you
verses.literalPt: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo, e o amor de Deus, e a comunhão do Espírito Santo seja com todos vós. Amém.
